caption: The drawing displays a section of wrought and cast iron balcony railing in black lines on a light beige background. The design measures 27 inches in width and 33 inches in height, as indicated by labeled dimension lines. The railing features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical balusters with elaborate, decorative motifs. Each baluster consists of acanthus-like leaves and fluted elements, and they are flanked by intricate scrollwork that curls extensively in both horizontal and vertical directions. The upper horizontal bar of the railing is adorned with continuous flowing scrolls and floral patterns, while the lower section is simpler, providing support. The scrolls each incorporate a small floral rosette at their centers. The drawing includes perspective lines and measurement notations, with the title "WROUGHT & CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" written in uppercase serif font at the bottom center.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
